name: Fan motors
description: Indoor and outdoor unit motor replacements.
long_description: Indoor blower motors move air across the cooling coil, and outdoor fan motors carry heat away from the condenser. A weak or noisy motor reduces cooling and strains the compressor. We supply motors matched by shaft size, rotation, RPM and mounting.
match_by: Shaft size, rotation, RPM and mounting

parts.name: Indoor blower motors
parts.detail: Cross-flow blower motors for wall-mounted indoor units.

parts.name: Outdoor condenser fan motors
parts.detail: Motors that carry heat away from the outdoor coil.

signs: Weak airflow from the indoor unit
Outdoor fan not spinning while the AC runs
